summary: Under the District Games initiative, Rotary Club of Mumbai North End adopted five football teams participating in a league for underprivileged and underserved children.
description: Under the District Games initiative, Rotary Club of Mumbai North End adopted five football teams participating in a league for underprivileged and underserved children. This initiative aimed to encourage young talent, promote sportsmanship and provide children with opportunities to showcase their football skills. The project reflects Rotary’s commitment to empowering children through sports and teamwork.
